articles.title: Viking no more: The real reason Erling Haaland cut off his iconic long hair
articles.standfirst: Manchester City star shaves his head bald for the new season
articles.summary: Manchester City star shaves his head bald for the new season
articles.body:
'Erling Haaland 's famous long hair no longer exists . The Manchester City superstar is sporting a new hairstyle for the new Premier League season: a buzz cut that went viral on social media on Sunday, before the team's opening match against Bournemouth.'

Haaland arrived at the Etihad Stadium for the match against Bournemouth wearing a cap , but he took it off during the warm-up, revealing his buzz cut.

The Norwegian forward has become one of the most recognizable sports stars of recent years thanks to his long hair .

Hours before the match between Manchester City and Bournemouth, Haaland posted a video on YouTube to confirm his decision. In the video, the striker said he had planned the haircut after the World Cup and wanted a new look to start from scratch .

In the same video, Zlatan Ibrahimovic asked the City striker if he had " lost a bet " when they showed him his new hairstyle. "So now you're going to be faster, or what?" said Ibrahimovic.

'Former City manager Pep Guardiola reacted to the haircut by saying: "You're lucky to have hair. I'd love to have it! ".'

articles.title: Erling Haaland's striking new look: the reactions of Zlatan Ibrahimovic, Pep Guardiola and Noel Gallagher
articles.standfirst: The Manchester City striker took advantage of the start of the new season and showed off his new look. He received amusing reactions from the world of football.
articles.summary: The Manchester City striker took advantage of the start of the new season and showed off his new look. He received amusing reactions from the world of football.
articles.body:
Erling showed off his new look and got some amusing reactions. He left behind his trademark blond mane and opted for a much shorter haircut, a transformation that quickly became one of the most talked-about topics among fans.

The Norwegian footballer documented the entire process through a seven-minute vlog published on his YouTube channel and unveiled his new short-haired look on social media on Sunday, accompanied by the comment: "New season, new haircut."

Erling Haaland is sporting a new haircut, getting rid of his iconic blond mane and opting for a much shorter cut, a transformation that quickly became one of the most talked-about topics among fans.

Once the haircut was finished, Haaland started making video calls to show his new look to various figures connected to Manchester City . One of the first was Noel Gallagher , a renowned musician from Oasis and a well-known fan of the English club. Upon seeing the footballer, Gallagher burst out laughing and assured him that he looked much younger.

The reaction of Zlatan Ibrahimovic also did not go unnoticed. When Haaland showed him his new look, the former Swedish striker asked him if he had lost a bet and described the decision as genuine madness. Zlatan 's response made even more sense because, in the past, he had advised Haaland not to cut his hair, referring to the importance of his characteristic mane.

Pep Guardiola also received a call from the striker. The Spanish coach was surprised to see the transformation and reacted with humor. Guardiola took advantage of the situation to joke with Haaland and about his own lack of hair, noting that the Norwegian was lucky to still have hair and that he would like to be in that situation.

Manchester City kicked off the Premier League with a victory

The Sky Blues were behind on the scoreboard against Bournemouth, for a long time, but in the final stretch they ended up snatching the win: 2-1.

Two goals in the final stretch of the match allowed Manchester City to come from behind and beat Bournemouth at home (2-1) this Sunday, allowing the new head coach Enzo Maresca to secure a first win in the Premier League opener.

The Norwegian number 9, sporting a new short-hair look, stood out with a header wide from a Djordje Petkovic corner (39'), a scuffed off-balance shot (72') and a very weak finish (75'). He also failed to connect properly with a good ball from Nico O"Reilly (13').

In the final stretch of the match, Manchester City finally managed to equalize. Marc Guehi appeared completely unmarked at a corner kick and headed the 1-1 into the back of the net.

Deep into stoppage time, the Citizens ended up taking the victory. After a great move by Rayan Cherki, Josko Gvardiol received the ball inside the box. He finished with his right foot, the weaker one, into the far post: 2-1.

articles.title: Infidelity and a new romance? The unusual video that may have exposed a Manchester City player
articles.standfirst: Rúben Dias once again found himself at the center of attention because of his love life. A video posted by a German model sparked suspicions, and a detail about the location led users to start connecting the dots.
articles.summary: Rúben Dias once again found himself at the center of attention because of his love life. A video posted by a German model sparked suspicions, and a detail about the location led users to start connecting the dots.
articles.body:
The Manchester City defender was part of a controversy involving a well-known model. A video that seemed completely harmless ended up prompting a deep investigation on social media. Users quickly found similarities between the place where the young woman appeared.

The footballer does not appear in the images. Nor is there a post in which either of the two confirms a relationship. The speculation arose for another reason: some users claim to have recognized the place.

The detail that sparked suspicion

Best, known on social media as Vally , appeared lying on a bed while recording a humorous video related to the pronunciation of words in English. The post seemed like just another one of her usual pieces of content, until some users began to notice the setting.

It was then that the comparisons began. Some users pointed out similarities between the details of the room and old images of a property linked to Dias and Maya Jama .

The comparisons went beyond the bedroom. Some users also found alleged similarities in the kitchen, the gym, and even outside the property. A photograph of Best near a Costa Coffee was interpreted as another clue, due to the existence of one of the chain’s locations close to the home.

A breakup that had already been surrounded by rumors

Dias and Maya Jama ended their relationship in April, after having bought the property shortly before last Christmas. At the time, reports mainly pointed to their professional commitments as one of the reasons for the breakup.

The separation was also accompanied by rumors of an alleged infidelity. Dias had previously been linked to Portuguese actress Daniela Melchior, although those reports never made it possible to confirm that an infidelity had existed. Could it have been the model in question?

Valentina Best is 28 years old and has a strong presence on social media. Her name had already appeared linked to the footballer in 2024.

Now, the video once again put them in the same place in conversations on social media. The difference is that this time users believe they have found a concrete clue in the setting.

So far, neither Dias nor Best has publicly confirmed that they are together. But the episode once again shows how an apparently ordinary post can end up becoming a collective investigation when the people involved are well-known figures.

articles.title: Manchester City break the bank for Bouaddi to offset Rodri's departure to Barcelona
articles.standfirst: The young French-Moroccan midfielder leaves €100 million in Lille's coffers and becomes the most expensive sale in the club's history
articles.summary: The young French-Moroccan midfielder leaves €100 million in Lille's coffers and becomes the most expensive sale in the club's history
articles.body:
Little, or virtually nothing, about Manchester City 's midfield will resemble the one Pep Guardiola was left with after the departures of Bernardo Silva and Rodrigo Hernández. First, they made Elliot Anderson the most expensive signing in their history... and they have just invested another 100 million euros —95 fixed and five in variables— in Ayyoub Bouaddi (Senlis, 2007) , who surpasses Nicolas Pepe as Lille 's biggest sale. He signs until 2031.

"For me, Manchester City is the best club in the world. It is a dream to be here and to be able to call myself a City player. I have dedicated most of my life to working hard to become the best player possible and reach the top of football," were Bouaddi 's first words as a new "cityzen" player.

He is barely 18 years old. But he leaves a Lille side that made him the youngest debutant in its history —16 years and three days old— with a total of 96 matches under his belt. A real ‘veteran’ who had already made a name for himself in the Champions 23-24 through his performances against Real Madrid, Juventus, Liverpool or Borussia Dortmund. In the opener against Angers with Davide Ancelotti in charge, however, he did not suit up and was seen saying goodbye to the fans who had traveled to the Stade Raymond Kopa.

At just 18 years old, he already possesses exceptional football intelligence

"At just 18 years old, he already possesses exceptional football intelligence, and that will only continue to improve under the guidance of Enzo Maresca," said Hugo Viana, Manchester City's sporting director. "We have followed him very closely and, throughout this entire process, we have become increasingly convinced that he is a great talent who will succeed at City".

His rise through the youth ranks of the French national team was meteoric… to the point of donning the captain’s armband with the U21 while being one of the youngest players in the squad. However, Morocco came calling, offering him the chance to play at the 2026 World Cup , and he decided not to wait for ‘Les Bleus’.

"I have made my choice and I am very proud of it. It is a relief to have made this decision. I am very happy to represent my country, Morocco . A big thank you to the Moroccan people and I hope we achieve beautiful things together. My family was very happy," clarified Bouaddi himself on the eve of the World Cup.

' Ouahbi put him straight into the starting eleven against Brazil and he delivered a debut to remember, in which he showed his overwhelming personality to receive the ball in deeper areas, withstand the opponents' pressure, and bring dynamism to the play through his passing. "He didn't impress me, because I already knew what kind of player he was. People get excited about him. Performing the way he did, at such a young age, is great. But remember that he has played big matches in the Champions ," said the Moroccan coach.'

I wasn't impressed, because I already knew what kind of player he was

"It is true that he went from more to less as the tournament progressed. But his performances were convincing enough to firmly place him on the radar of teams like Real Madrid, PSG or a Manchester City that, although it sounded out other names such as Enzo Fernández or Adam Wharton , has broken the bank to sign the Moroccan.

In principle, he arrives at the Etihad with the label of being a starter in midfield alongside Elliot Anderson . In addition to Rodri and Bernardo, Reijnders headed to Al Qadsiah and Nico González is finalizing his move to Newcastle . Against Bournemouth , Guéhi even started as an "anchor".

'The responsibility is enormous. Above all, considering where it comes from, Manchester City. "I still have a lot to improve," acknowledged Bouaddi himself. But, at every step he has taken during his early years of his career, he has always shown that the challenges were never too big for him.'

articles.title: Xabi Alonso leaves Enzo Fernández out and his move to Manchester City heats up
articles.standfirst: The Argentine was not included in the squad against Luton, and in England they point to an imminent offer from the team managed by Enzo Maresca. Chelsea, open to a sale
articles.summary: The Argentine was not included in the squad against Luton, and in England they point to an imminent offer from the team managed by Enzo Maresca. Chelsea, open to a sale
articles.body:
Enzo Fernández's departure from Chelsea heats up even more after being left out of the Carabao Cup match

The Argentine, who had already made it clear before the summer that he wanted to leave Stamford Bridge , was not included in the squad against Luton and Xabi Alonso stated that it was an exclusively sporting decision. In England, however, they indicate that Manchester City are considering submitting an offer for the midfielder before the close of the transfer window.

Enzo Fernández's situation at Chelsea is back in the spotlight. The Argentine midfielder was left out of the squad for the Carabao Cup second-round match in a decision taken personally by Xabi Alonso , as the coach himself confirmed after the game.

The decision not to call him up was mine

The Spanish coach wanted to downplay the absence of the Argentine international and assured that he is a "very professional" footballer who is training well. Alonso explained that his decision was related to managing the squad's minutes and to the specific needs of the match.

"It was simply because of today's match. We have other players who need minutes" , Alonso explained at the press conference after the win against Luton. Asked when he had made the decision to leave Enzo out, the coach was clear: " Wednesday afternoon. It was a decision I made myself".

Enzo is a good professional. He is training well and I have nothing to say about that

Alonso also wanted to leave the door open to his return for the next league fixture, this Sunday against Brighton at Stamford Bridge: "Enzo is a good professional. He is training well and I have nothing to say about that. They are simply decisions we have to make with the match we were playing tonight in mind. We'll see on Sunday ".

The absence of Enzo Fernández becomes even more significant after reports from England of Manchester City's interest in the Argentine footballer. According to Sky Sports, the side managed by Enzo Maresca is considering the possibility of making an offer for Enzo before the transfer window closes, set for Tuesday at 11:00 p.m. ... and that Chelsea are willing to listen.

articles.title: Revolution at Manchester City: Pep Guardiola's departure causes an unprecedented historic exodus
articles.standfirst: The ‘cityzen’ side has raised 336.9 million in sales this summer when, to date, its ‘record high’ stood at 161.9 ‘million’
articles.summary: The ‘cityzen’ side has raised 336.9 million in sales this summer when, to date, its ‘record high’ stood at 161.9 ‘million’
articles.body:
The arrival of Sheikh Mansour marked a before and after in the history of a Manchester City that, since then, has won eight Premier titles and, above all, its first and long-awaited Champions . All of this having invested 3.39 billion euros in signings, surpassed only by Chelsea (3.86). Guardiola 's departure, however, has led to an exodus that is turning the ‘cityzen’ club’s market into a record-breaking summer.

In recent years, Manchester City also began to become an exemplary club when it came to offloading assets to finance the purchase of new pieces. So much so that, since the summer of 2022, they have been bringing in more than 100 million in each and every one of these seasons. The ‘ceiling’ was set in 22-23 with 161.9 million in income from player sales. An amount that has doubled in this window to reach 336.9 ‘million’.

Sales income for Man. City since Sheikh Mansour's arrival:

The appointment of Enzo Maresca , which took longer to arrive than expected due to certain legal matters pending resolution with Chelsea , was meant to draw a continuous line with the rebuilding already begun by Pep Guardiola , who had him on his staff during the 22-23 season. “He was the candidate who stood out the most in our evaluations. We know his personality and his vision of how football should be played. He is upright, charismatic, and passionate. In addition to his successes at Chelsea and Leicester , his track record at City speaks for itself,” explained Ferran Soriano , the club’s CEO .

“Probably the reason I’m here is also because the club’s idea is to maintain the same style and approach. But we’re going to try to do what matters most, which is to win,” pointed out Enzo Maresca , who, however, also wanted to distance himself from the figure of Pep . “I’m not here to try to be a copy of anyone. Every coach is different. Probably, I don’t see football in the same way as the previous coach.”

I’m not here to try to be a copy of anyone

To a certain extent, it was part of the plans to continue offloading the men from the 2023 ‘treble’: Stones, Aké, Akanji, Bernardo and even a Rodrigo Hernández who had one year left on his contract. However, Maresca has not put up any obstacle to ‘dismantling’ the work carried out during the last transfer windows: of the 10 major departures this summer, as many as five involved players who had been at the club for less than two years.

Alongside Savinho , who has overtaken Julián Alvarez as the most expensive sale (88 million) in City history, Reijnders (61) and Rodri (60) have also broken into the club’s Top 5 biggest sales. If the focus is widened to the 10 biggest transfers completed by the ‘cityzen’ side, Nico González (56) also appears. In addition to these four names, there are also James Trafford , whom Leeds has made the most expensive English goalkeeper (47) of all time; and a Marmoush who has gone on loan to Tottenham with an obligation to buy —subject to conditions— set at 58 million.

The most expensive sales in Man. City history:

Savinho ($87.7 million/Tottenham)

Julián Alvarez (75 million/Atlético de Madrid)

Tijjani Reijnders (61 million/Al Qadsiah)

Rodri Hernández (Barcelona/60 million)

Raheem Sterling (56.2 million/Chelsea)

Nico González (56 million/Newcastle)

Ferran Torres (55 million/Barcelona)

Gabriel Jesus (52 million/Arsenal)

Cole Palmer ($47 million/Chelsea)

Such an amount of money brought in by all these sales has overshadowed the fact that City has spent 274 million on signings —only Chelsea (398) and Tottenham (354) have spent more— this summer. The vast majority, however, has gone toward funding the arrivals of Elliot Anderson , the most expensive signing (135) in their entire history, and Ayyoub Bouaddi , whom they have made the 18-year-old player for whom the most money (95) has ever been paid. Joining them are Detourbet (25), loaned to Monaco after being signed from their Troyes ‘affiliate’, the very young Jeremy Monga (2009), Gero Rulli (3.5) and Pierce Charles (3.5).

“It’s the market and anything can happen. We’ll see, there are still four or five days left. But, at this moment, it’s quite complicated for me to think about this,” he said ahead of tonight’s match against Crystal Palace. He did stress, however, that he would like “to have two players for each position.” Otherwise, he will look to the academy, where McAidoo, Floyd Samba or Kaden Braithwaite are pushing through.

It's the market and anything can happen

Maresca , in any case, is not satisfied... despite the fact that green shoots had begun to appear against Crystal Palace. Allan , a winger from Palmeiras , will come in to fill the gap left by Savinho after agreeing to a 40 million transfer; and Enzo Fernández could be the big ‘bombshell’ in this final stretch of the transfer window for a fee that would surpass Elliot Anderson himself as the most expensive signing in the club’s history. Four days remain in the transfer window and there is ‘fresh’ money in the Etihad’s coffers.

Alongside Savinho , who has overtaken Julián Alvarez as the most expensive sale (88 million) in City history, Reijnders (61) and Rodri (60) have also broken into the club’s Top 5 biggest sales. If the focus is widened to the 10 biggest transfers completed by the ‘cityzen’ side, Nico González (56) also appears. In addition to these four names, there are also James Trafford , whom Leeds has made the most expensive English goalkeeper (47) of all time; and a Marmoush who has gone on loan to Tottenham with an obligation to buy —subject to conditions— set at 58 million.
The most expensive sales in Man. City history:
Savinho ($87.7 million/Tottenham)
Julián Alvarez (75 million/Atlético de Madrid)
Tijjani Reijnders (61 million/Al Qadsiah)
Rodri Hernández (Barcelona/60 million)
Raheem Sterling (56.2 million/Chelsea)
Nico González (56 million/Newcastle)
Ferran Torres (55 million/Barcelona)
Gabriel Jesus (52 million/Arsenal)
Cole Palmer ($47 million/Chelsea)

Such an amount of money brought in by all these sales has overshadowed the fact that City has spent 274 million on signings —only Chelsea (398) and Tottenham (354) have spent more— this summer. The vast majority, however, has gone toward funding the arrivals of Elliot Anderson , the most expensive signing (135) in their entire history, and Ayyoub Bouaddi , whom they have made the 18-year-old player for whom the most money (95) has ever been paid. Joining them are Detourbet (25), loaned to Monaco after being signed from their Troyes ‘affiliate’, the very young Jeremy Monga (2009), Gero Rulli (3.5) and Pierce Charles (3.5).

But, at this moment, it’s quite complicated for me to think about this,” he said ahead of tonight’s match against Crystal Palace. He did stress, however, that he would like “to have two players for each position.” Otherwise, he will look to the academy, where McAidoo, Floyd Samba or Kaden Braithwaite are pushing through.
It's the market and anything can happen

Maresca , in any case, is not satisfied... despite the fact that green shoots had begun to appear against Crystal Palace. Allan , a winger from Palmeiras , will come in to fill the gap left by Savinho after agreeing to a 40 million transfer; and Enzo Fernández could be the big ‘bombshell’ in this final stretch of the transfer window for a fee that would surpass Elliot Anderson himself as the most expensive signing in the club’s history. Four days remain in the transfer window and there is ‘fresh’ money in the Etihad’s coffers.
